spans.s:
(औ, इर) औछिदिर r. 7th cl. (छिनत्ति छिंत्ते)
To divided, to split, to cut, &c. With the prefix आङ्, To seize, to lay hold of. With the prefix उत, To slay or kill.

f. (-दा)
Cutting, dividing.
E.
छिद, as above, affixes अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-द् or त्)
Cutting, destroying, who or what cuts.
E.
छिद to cut, affix क्विप्.

n. (-कं)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
छिद to cut or split, affix क्वन्; also छिदिक.

f. (-दिः)
An axe.
E.
छिद to cut, इ Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel unchanged.

A rope, a cord.
3 A sword.
4 An axe, a hatchet.
E.
छिद to cut, किरच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Cutting, dividing, what cuts or divides.
2 A knave.
3 Hostile, a foe.
E.
छिद to cut, and कुरच् aff.

r. 10th cl. (छिद्रयति)
1 To pierce, to bore, to perforate, to make openings or holes.
2 To perforate the ear for rings, &c.

n. (-द्रं)
1 A hole, a vacuity, a perforation, &c.
2 Fault, defect, flaw, (moral or physical.)
3 A weak side.
4 Infirmity.
E.
छिद to pierce, Uṇādi affix रक्.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं)
Having the ears pierced.
E.
छिद्र, and कर्ण the ear.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Looking out for faults or flaws.
E.
छिद्र, and अनुसारिन् who pursues.

m. (-न्तः)
A reed.
E.
छिद्र, and अन्तर् within.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Seeking for faults, malicious.
E.
छिद्र, and अन्वेषिन् searching.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Perforated, pierced, having holes or openings.
E.
छिद्र to pierce, affix क्त.
